events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and the US has shown its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The war has become a test of military, economy, and geopolitics. The Atlantic Council has outlined four scenarios for geopolitics after the Iran war.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will likely lead to increased gold prices due to safe-haven demand, while emerging markets may suffer from the geopolitical uncertainty.
